ret: 1 training day (I) holding 1 exercise, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed.
Rotation: Do Day I once every day.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 1 time each day. If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
Reads your pain rating the morning after the last session (checked in before the session; ignored once older than a day).
iso: 5 sets of 45 s holds on Isometric Calf-Raise Hold, resting 2 min between holds, for pain relief.
